architecture.mechanism: deep-neural-network-based object detection algorithm for identifying structural defects
architecture.intervention: Adapt the CNN algorithm to analyze interior vehicle cabin imagery for early detection of overhead console mounting point degradation (cracks, spalling) before detachment occurs.
architecture.expected_effect: Early identification of structural weaknesses in console attachment points prevents sudden detachment while maintaining clear windshield visibility and dash camera field of view.
architecture.falsification_test: Deploy the adapted algorithm on a test fleet; if it fails to detect known pre-failure cracks in overhead console mounts identified via post-teardown analysis in more than 10% of cases, the mechanism is invalid.
